title: Twist Bioscience reports fiscal third-quarter 2026 financial results
publisher: Twist Bioscience Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Fiscal Q3 revenue grew 23% to USD 118.4 million, gross margin reached 52.8%, and fiscal 2026 revenue guidance rose to USD 456-457 million.
summary: The SEC-filed earnings release supplies current segment growth, margin, adjusted-EBITDA, customer and gene-shipment, liquidity, and fiscal 2026 guidance evidence.
